sections.title: Morning
paragraphs: The queue kept its shape in the rain. They were seen from the yard. A man with a yellow bag waited under the awning.
She wrote the hour and the colour. The third column was left blank. Mr Pell did not fill it.

sections.title: The letter
paragraphs: The shop wanted six bowls by the first of the month. She wrote the date and the price. The pots were seen through the vent.
A train passed and the racks clicked. Nobody looked up. She locked the gate after the others had gone.
